title.narrative: Technological and Enterprise Upgrading Programme focused on agro-chemical and agriculture machinery production sector (Industrial Upgrading and Modernization in Cuba)

description.narrative: The pilot project #Technological and Enterprise Upgrading Programme on agro-chemicals and agricultural machinery production sector (Industrial Upgrading and Modernization in Cuba)# (ID 150262) spanned during the period of 6 years (2016-2022). According to the #Sectoral Strategy for the technological and enterprise upgrading of fertilizers and agricultural machinery# that was developed during the initial stages of implementation, taking into account the eventual amount of mobilized funding (USD 2,000,000 - 50% of the initially envisaged budget), it was recommended that the technical assistance during the project#s pilot phase should only focus on reinforcing production capacities of the agro-chemicals/fertilizer industry in Cuba. As a result of the project, two pilot fertilizer plants were upgraded (CIIQ #RevoluciĆ³n de Octubre# fertilizers manufacturing plant in Havana and EMPREQUIN in Nuevitas), ensuring the necessary fine-tuning within the production process of calcium nitrate, while also promoting innovative liquid fertilizer CBFERT/VITAPLIC Foliar.
